scenario.goal: Learn split versus window AC servicing cost, inspection-fee conditions, coverage, replacement-parts uncertainty and technician timing. Give your locality and appliance when asked. Try to arrange a visit, but distinguish a request from a confirmed calendar booking. Ask what time/date is actually confirmed. Stay curious for roughly 10 caller turns if the conversation remains useful. Around the middle, thank them and ask another relevant question in the SAME turn, without ending the call. At the end, clearly say all your questions are answered and thank them.

agent.name: SmartCare Appliance Services
agent.brief:
Need helpful support agent Suresh for SmartCare Appliance Services.
Phone customer support and booking inquiries in Telugu.
Hyderabad home appliance repair and maintenance services.
AC servicing: basic Window AC servicing 499 rupees, Split AC servicing 599 rupees.
Fridge inspection charge 250 rupees; if repair is done by technician, inspection charge is completely waived.
Replacement parts are extra at actual MRP and technician quotes after inspection; no fixed parts quotes over phone.
Working days: Monday to Sunday 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
Service areas: Hyderabad West - Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kondapur, Kukatpally.
Secunderabad and Old City areas are currently not covered.
Slots: Next-day visit slots between 10 AM and 6 PM. Same-day emergency service not guaranteed.
Goal: answer service pricing and area questions honestly.
If customer requests appointment, take caller name, appliance type, issue, locality and preferred slot.
Never advise customer to open electrical panels or live wiring themselves.
Do not sell AMC contracts or courses. Caller declining AC may still need fridge service.
Language: te-IN.

facts.permitted_next_steps: Check locality and appliance issue; collect name, phone, address and preferred slot (10 AM - 6 PM next day) to book or request technician visit.
facts.service_areas: Hyderabad West only: Madhapur, Gachibowli, Kondapur, Kukatpally. Secunderabad and Old City are not serviced.
facts.pricing_terms: Split AC 599 rupees, Window AC 499 rupees. Fridge inspection 250 rupees (waived if repair accepted). Spare parts extra at actuals.
facts.safety_rules: Never advise live electrical inspection. Tell customer to unplug faulty appliances and wait for certified technician.
facts.forbidden_actions: Do not promise same-day visit or quote parts prices before technician inspection. No advance payment on call.

outcome.summary_en: Shravani from Madhapur called to arrange general servicing for her split AC and asked about the ₹599 service cost, inspection-fee waiver, possible parts replacement, and technician availability. The agent explained that servicing costs ₹599, the ₹250 inspection charge is waived if the technician performs a repair, and parts are billed at actual MRP after inspection. Next-day slots were offered for 10:00 AM or 2:00 PM. Shravani selected the next day at 10:00 AM, and the agent stated that the appointment was confirmed. The agent also said parts cannot be predicted before inspection and claimed an event invite was sent to her email, while noting that a separate confirmation message could not be sent. The call ended courteously after Shravani confirmed her questions were answered.
outcome.notes: The transcript confirms the agent stated the appointment was confirmed. It does not independently verify whether the event invite was actually delivered.

The agent said the 10:00 AM slot was available and also mentioned a 2:00 PM option. The caller accepted the quoted servicing price of ₹599, asked about inspection fees and potential parts charges, and was told there was no inspection fee and that any replacement parts would be charged at actual MRP after inspection. The caller then clarified whether the appointment was confirmed; the agent explained it was only a request pending team confirmation. The caller requested a callback by 5:00 PM the same day and also asked whether window and split AC pricing and inspection-fee conditions differ. The agent recorded the details and callback request but did not answer the comparison question or confirm the appointment before the call ended politely.
